description: This file contains test setup code for the Kubernetes API extensions server, including functions to start and manage a test server instance, handle configuration, and perform health checks.

classes.name: TestServer
classes.description: Represents a test instance of the Kubernetes API extensions server, including configuration, client info, and teardown function.

classes.name: TestServerInstanceOptions
classes.description: Holds options for configuring a test server instance.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Interface for logging within test server functions, supporting Errorf, Fatalf, and Logf.

methods.name: NewDefaultTestServerOptions
methods.description: Creates default options for a test server instance.

methods.name: StartTestServer
methods.description: Starts a Kubernetes API extensions test server, returning configuration, client info, and a teardown function.

methods.name: StartTestServerOrDie
methods.description: Starts a test server or fails the test if startup fails.

methods.name: createLocalhostListenerOnFreePort
methods.description: Creates a TCP listener on localhost with a free port.

methods.name: pkgPath
methods.description: Determines the absolute path to the package directory, handling bazel and go test environments.
